sentences.japanese: 去る時はドアを閉めてください。
sentences.english: Close the door when you leave.

sentences.japanese: 出る時にドアをお閉めください。
sentences.english: Please will you close the door when you go out.

sentences.japanese: 君は全部のドアを施錠するか、せめて閉じるべきだった。
sentences.english: You should have locked, or at least closed, all the doors.

sentences.japanese: 銀行がいつ閉まるかわかりますか。
sentences.english: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?

sentences.japanese: 教科書を閉じて私の言うことを聞きなさい。
sentences.english: Listen to me with your textbooks closed.
